Hero_Desc_Ronnie: Ronnie, a fairy who exiled herself to the desolate wilderness. Only after leaving behind a lonely life that had festered in one place could she take a step away from her foolish past. Despite her long seclusion, her skills have not rusted in the slightest.
Album_Ronnie1: Ronnie starts each morning with light stretches and training. Recently she added another step to her routine: staring blankly at a weed growing in the shade. I offered to move it into the sunlight, but she said she wanted to watch it grow on its own.
Album_Ronnie2: Bella accompanies Ronnie on walks through her changed homeland. Years of solitude made Ronnie taciturn, so the ever-chatty Bella at her side seems to be the perfect companion.
Album_Ronnie3: Ronnie sometimes sinks into thought with a bitter look. The other day, she watched the sunset and murmured that she wished her desolate heart could set along with it.
Album_Ronnie4: Whenever Ronnie crouches with a lollipop in her mouth, nearby fairies vanish in an instant. Taking her through a crowd should at least keep anyone from picking a fight.
Album_Ronnie5: When you meet rookie guards patrolling late at night, Ronnie is usually nearby. She may watch with a proud smile, mutter that they need more discipline, or drift into memories with a distant look.
Album_Ronnie6: Dawn in Erpien is not cold, yet Ronnie habitually lights a campfire before the Order. We spent a long while listening to the wood crackle. Maybe I should bring marshmallows next time...
Album_Ronnie7: On mornings when I wake early, I often find Ronnie gazing up at the brightening sky. She unclenches her fist, turns, and smiles, her face perfectly matching the newborn sunlight.
LoveHero_Ronnie: For my precious homeland, the home I can return to... and for you, Master, I will keep moving forward.
LoveHeroCancel_Ronnie: Ugh... I never knew watching someone's back could leave such a bitter feeling.
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Hate1: She chewed through it like dry grass, then politely asked me never to serve her anything like it again.
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Hate2: She said Bella had recommended it and took a huge bite, only for her expression to turn fierce. She forced a smile, but stared at the pudding as if it were her mortal enemy.
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Like1: Ronnie closed her eyes, saying it reminded her of wandering the wilderness. She seemed to savor the memory more than the flavor.
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Like10: She leapt up and began waving both hands in a bizarre dance. Is it some ritual for expressing an astonishing flavor?
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Like2: She said the glittering gold resembled the sunset and made her feel as though she were swallowing the sun. It was a sweetness that set her heart ablaze.
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Like3: She loved the rich warmth filling her stomach, saying one bowl would carry her through even the coldest dawn in the wilderness.
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Like4: I put in candles to celebrate her return home, and she suddenly started building a campfire. Surely she isn't going to...?
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Like5: Ronnie mistook it for sand and nearly blew on it before I stopped her. She poured it into her mouth and exclaimed that it tasted nothing like sand.
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Like6: She studied its intricate shape, then asked for the recipe, saying it might be nice to make whenever she felt lonely.
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Like7: She instantly melted the chocolate inside and marveled at how long it had been since she tasted such worldly sweetness, looking moved beyond words.
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Like8: Her troubled face brightened at once. Starting with 'Back in my day...' she launched into tales of her exploits in active service.
Food_ChefNote_Ronnie_Like9: She swallowed hard, saying it looked several times more expensive than her usual candy. As it melted away, she repeatedly tried to grasp a stick that was not there.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Ronnie: I wandered lost for countless years, but...
Gacha_Result_Line1_Ronnie: From now on, I will find where I belong.
Ronnie_Spawn1: I will bring life back to this place.
Ronnie_Spawn2: I will move forward without losing my way.
Ronnie_Growth2: Ugh... Have my skills grown rusty?
Ronnie_Victory1: The path I walked was not wrong.
Ronnie_Defeat2: Darn... I must work even harder.
Ronnie_Affinity1_1: Good day. I hope today treats you well.
Ronnie_Affinity1_2: Will I really be able to do this well?
Ronnie_Affinity2: I do not want to wander anymore...
Ronnie_Affinity1_3: Lately, I have been thinking about how to control my anger.
Ronnie_Affinity3: It is true that I have many worries... If you do not mind, would you listen for a moment?
Ronnie_Affinity4: Would you watch the sunset with me next time? Even a restless heart can grow calm beneath that light.
Ronnie_Affinity5: I feel as though I could share even the regrets that have pooled in my heart for so long with you, Master.
Ronnie_Affinity6: Is there something you treasure above all else, Master? I am very curious what it might be.
Ronnie_Affinity7: Hahaha! I feel as if a weight has lifted from my chest! Thanks to you, Master, I feel much better.
Ronnie_Die2: Ugh... Have my skills grown rusty?
Ronnie_LevelUp: This feels even better than I expected.
Ronnie_Equipment: I think I will soon grow attached to these too.
Ronnie_HeroSkill: It feels as though things are gradually coming to a close.
Ronnie_HeroUpgrade: Another light now shines upon my journey.
Ronnie_Board: Would you follow in my footsteps?
Ronnie_DeckSetting1: You will not regret this choice.
Ronnie_DeckSetting2: Shall I show what I can do after all this time?
Ronnie_Stage: I will take care of it at once.
Ronnie_Touch1: Master, I never expected this from you... What a surprise attack!
Ronnie_Touch1_1: Ugh... Please let go of me!
Ronnie_Touch2_1: Your hands are truly large. They feel dependable.
Ronnie_Touch2: Ah... I can feel all that built-up fatigue melting away...
Ronnie_Touch2_2: Thank you. Your praise always lifts my spirits, Master.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Ronnie_Skin1: Ronnie gazing leisurely into the distance as the sun sets.
Ronnie_Growth1_Skin1: The wilderness wind is warm today.
Ronnie_Growth2_Skin1: The harmonica sounds especially pleasant today.
Ronnie_LevelUp_Skin1: Nights in the wilderness are long and lonely, but enduring them is how you grow.
Ronnie_Equipment_Skin1: The law of the West is simple. The one with better gear and a faster shot survives.
Ronnie_HeroSkill_Skin1: A trigger is meant to be pulled!
Ronnie_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Whew... The wind is picking up. Shall we get started?
Ronnie_Board_Skin1: Keep up before the sun sets. Night work does not suit me.
Ronnie_Touch1_Skin1: Hmm... Are you trying to brush the desert sand from my cheek?
Ronnie_Touch1_1_Skin1: Ugh. Only until the sun has fully set! After that, take your hands off me!
Ronnie_Touch1_2_Skin1: Let me go! The wind is calling! I need to answer it now!
Ronnie_Touch2_Skin1: Do not treat me like such a child... I have been through my share of hardships.
Ronnie_Touch2_1_Skin1: An affectionate touch like this is not so bad once in a while.
Ronnie_Touch2_2_Skin1: A fine touch. If you cannot sleep someday, lean on my shoulder. I will keep watch.
Ronnie_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Face me fair and square, by the law of the West!
Aside_Get_Ronnie1: A Golden Hand badge... It brings up complicated feelings.
Aside_Upgrade_Ronnie1: I will learn from the past and become better.
Ronnie_AsideGet: A Golden Hand badge... It brings up complicated feelings.
Ronnie_AsideUpgrade: I will learn from the past and become better.
Aside_Desc_Ronnie: A Golden Hand-shaped badge Ronnie once planned to make after personally arresting Golden Hand and seeing her properly punished. It seems she has not completely let go of her fixation on Marie.
Ronnie_AsideGet1: A Golden Hand badge... It brings up complicated feelings.
Ronnie_AsideUpgrade1: I will learn from the past and become better.
Ronnie_Birthday: So today is your birthday. Congratulations. Just for today, I hope you do everything you wish without regret!
Ronnie_Gacha2: From now on, I will find where I belong!
Ronnie_Gacha3: I wandered lost for countless years, but...
Ronnie_Greeting: Hahaha! It is good to see you!
Ronnie_Line1: Are you curious what the recorder meant to me...?
Ronnie_Line2: If there is something you wish to protect, never let your guard down. Stay close beside it at all times.
Ronnie_Line3: I would like some time to sort through the worries gathered in my heart.
Ronnie_Lobby: Ah... I miss my recorder especially much today...
Ronnie_StartJourney1: Do not worry. I will not leave your side.
Ronnie_StartJourney2: There seem to be plenty of ruffians in need of a lesson.
LoveLetter_Ronnie:
Hello, Master. This is Ronnie.

You crossed my mind before bed, so I decided to write this letter.
Master, thank you for everything.
It would be no exaggeration to say that I was able to overcome my past and grow because of you.
It is embarrassing, but I have always wanted to tell you this. I find it difficult to say aloud very often... so from now on, I will try to share my feelings with you in ways like this.

I look forward to staying by your side, Master. Sincerely, Ronnie.
LoveCall_Ronnie:
Oh, you picked up right away. Hello, Master...
...Hm? You say I sound down? Ahem, honestly...
I really cannot hide anything from you, Master. You truly are...
How do you know me so well? And why... do you trust me so deeply...?
You once told me it was all right to lose my way and wander. Even then, you said I would eventually find a path of my own.
...Do you remember?
As I spoke with you, always beside me and believing in me, I must have begun relying on you without even realizing it.
If I ever rely on you too much and become a burden, please tell me without hesitation.

...What? You say I may rely on you even more than I do now? R-really?! Haha!
Ah, pardon me. I became too excited. Ahem. Th-then... may I truly lean on you more freely?
The truth is, something has been troubling me lately, and I have been suffering over it alone...
I would like to visit you privately soon and share the worry hidden deep in my heart.
Until next time, Master!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP01_001: Master, who has the right to forgive a person's wrongdoing?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP01_003: Neither am I. What is the right way to make amends for one's mistakes?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP01_005: Resentment you cannot release ultimately turns against you... I see. I understand.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP01_007: Ugh... So I should simply vent my anger after all? Just let me catch someone...
Affinity_Ronnie_EP02_001: If no one ever did wrong, there would be no need for the Guard, would there?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP02_002: But that would be impossible, wouldn't it?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP02_003: I suppose so. It leaves a bitter taste.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP02_004: But Ronnie has made mistakes too...
Affinity_Ronnie_EP02_006: The Guard is not an organization that hunts down every mistake.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP02_007: Oh. I had forgotten. You are right. Patrols are not solely about maintaining order.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP03_001: I think I understand why punishment exists.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP03_003: What? Why are you suddenly looking at me like that? Um... Master?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP03_004: So people will not do wrong again.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP03_006: It also means a debt has been paid.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP03_007: A fair punishment seems to help us forgive others, and ourselves.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP04_001: The Phantom of Being... What would she say if you asked her about me?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP04_003: Hehe. That truly sounds like her. It is so concise that it actually helps.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP04_004: Bella does not hold grudges, so do not worry.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP04_005: Ah... I see. I must work harder to change her impression of me.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP04_007: That is not wrong... and I can imagine the phantom saying it... but somehow...
Affinity_Ronnie_EP05_001: Sometimes I want to leave Erpien and return to the wilderness.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP05_002: Who will patrol the Order if Ronnie leaves?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP05_003: Even without me, there is Captain Polan... More than anything, I wish for a future in which patrols are no longer needed.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP05_004: Are you having some kind of difficulty?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP05_005: No. It is not that. In the wilderness, I only had myself to worry about.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP05_006: You do not have to carry everything alone.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP05_007: Such consideration means a great deal to me... Hehe, it is nothing. Thank you, Master.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP06_001: They say there is something to learn from everything in the world. I believe that is true.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP06_002: Was there something to learn from Golden Hand too?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP06_003: In many ways. There were many things. Yes, many.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP06_005: Embarrassingly, I learned from my own mistakes. A cautionary example, was it?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP06_006: What matters is the willingness to learn.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP07_001: What should I do if I make a mistake as sheriff?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP07_002: Instead of planning to fail, think about succeeding!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP07_003: I had forgotten what matters most. I will set my mind straight.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP07_004: You can think about it when it happens.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP07_005: That is sound advice, but the wrong answer for me. I am the sheriff. By then, it would be too late.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP07_007: Perhaps. But as sheriff, I want to hold myself to a stricter standard.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP08_001: Being sheriff may not suit a fairy like me. What should I do?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP08_002: Honestly, I feel the same way about myself.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP08_003: You, Master? Are you not being too modest?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP08_004: The fact that you question yourself proves you are qualified.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP08_005: M-may I really think that way? Hearing it from you reassures me.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP08_006: If I think you are unsuited, I will tell you.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP08_007: Th-that is frightening in its own way.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP09_001: Someone fled the instant they saw me today. What was that about?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP09_003: I had not considered that. Ugh... Why does my chest feel...
Affinity_Ronnie_EP09_006: What if you approach with a smile?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP09_007: I am not good at it, but I will practice.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP10_001: So this is what it feels like to have somewhere to return to.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP10_002: Yes. It lets you prepare for tomorrow.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP10_003: Exactly. Now I can look toward the future instead of the past.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP10_004: What do you think has changed?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP10_005: It comforts me somehow. It means there are people waiting for me.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP10_006: Now you need to clean your house diligently too.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP10_007: Even I would not turn it into a pigsty...! Th-that is not what you meant in the first place, is it?!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP11_001: Lollipops taste special in the banquet hall. Do you have a favorite food, Master?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP11_002: If I had to pick one, perhaps strawberry cake?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP11_003: Of course. Her Majesty likes it too.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP11_004: When it comes to banquet food, it has to be phantom pudding!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP11_005: M-Master, I never knew you had such a bizarre palate...!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP11_007: Exactly! That is it! You and I truly understand each other, Master!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP12_001: On my way here, I saw members of the Guard napping. Honestly, it was surely during their shift...
Affinity_Ronnie_EP12_002: That will not do. As their senior, why not give them a stern warning?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP12_003: Oh! So you agree, Master! I will be sure to do that next time!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP12_004: Do not be too hard on them. You are no longer their superior.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP12_005: Ah...! R-right. Perhaps I was overstepping.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP12_006: What if you just show your face for a moment?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP12_007: Hmm. Indeed, that alone may be warning enough.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP13_001: Back in my Guard days, danger lurked in every alley of Erpien. I wonder how things are now.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP13_002: Dangerous. There is a delinquent threatening everyone with a spinning top, and a fairy always trying to add me to a collection...!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP13_003: Canta aside, what do you mean someone wants to collect you...?! U-um. A sheriff bears a heavy responsibility.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP13_004: Probably similar? Moderately dangerous and moderately safe?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP13_006: The alleys are safe now. Polan and your old comrades are doing well.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP13_007: I see... Hehe. Then I am relieved.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP14_001: I saw a recorder in a music shop window on the way here. How should I put it... I had complicated feelings.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP14_002: Go inside next time. Your friend the recorder may hope Ronnie will make music again someday.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP14_003: If you say so, Master... Yes. Next time I will find the courage.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP14_004: It will get easier with time.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP14_005: Yes. Someday... that day will come.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP14_006: Wait, Ronnie...! Are you already eyeing another recorder?!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP15_001: Master, um... Do you enjoy listening to songs?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP15_002: Of course! If I get the chance, I would love to hear Ronnie and the Guard perform together.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP15_003: R-really? Hehe. If that is what you want, perhaps when the opportunity comes...
Affinity_Ronnie_EP15_004: Not particularly. Singing disturbs me when I sleep...
Affinity_Ronnie_EP15_005: Ah, of course... You always have so much work, Master.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP15_006: Well, if I had to say, I do not dislike it?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP15_007: Then you should hear a truly fine song at least once.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP16_001: The elves' city has so many fascinating things. It feels new every time I visit.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP16_002: Time flies when you play at the arcade.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP16_003: It truly does. I meant to play with that phantom for only a moment, but when I came to my senses, the sun was setting.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP16_004: Shall we go together next time? Ronnie, Bella, and all the other elves can gather and have fun.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP16_005: Hehe. I would gladly accept that invitation. It sounds delightful already.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP16_006: Try the space rations while you are there. They are delicious.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP16_007: Master... Even I know space rations taste awful.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP17_001: Master. Does Golden Hand... no, does Marie visit the banquet hall often?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP17_002: She does... but no fighting in the banquet hall, all right?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP17_004: Fairly often. She startled me by asking how to make bombs.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP17_005: M-Marie... Perhaps she is still a little dangerous after all?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP17_006: Come to think of it, I have not seen her lately. Why not come together next time? I will tell Marie.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP17_007: Would that really be all right? Th-thank you, Master.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP18_001: Sometimes I miss the days when I wandered the wilderness.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP18_002: When you surrender yourself to the bleak wind and walk the wastes... you begin to feel as if you and the wilderness are one...
Affinity_Ronnie_EP18_003: Yes! Exactly, Master! You truly understand style!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP18_004: If you miss it that much, why not live that way again for a little while?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP18_005: I am not sure. I have duties here now.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP18_006: Ugh, I could never live like that. I hear it is freezing there.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP19_001: I have many worries about returning to work after so long. What if my skills have rusted...?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP19_002: If they really have, perhaps you cannot remain sheriff...
Affinity_Ronnie_EP19_003: D-do not say that! I will never give up!
Affinity_Ronnie_EP19_004: Do not worry. Ronnie's skills look unchanged to me.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP19_005: Really? Hehe. Hearing you say that puts me at ease, Master.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP19_006: Just keep moving forward, regardless of skill.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP19_007: You are right. It is exactly as you say, Master.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP20_001: I would like something to drink, Master.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP20_002: How about a hot iced Americano?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP20_003: Hmm... It is unfamiliar, but if you recommend it, I will gladly try it.
Affinity_Ronnie_EP20_004: Hmph. Coconut pine-needle porridge is enough for a brat, is it not?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP20_005: U-ugh...! Are you looking down on me?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP20_006: This is a secret grape juice prepared especially for Ronnie. It was hard to find, you know?
Affinity_Ronnie_EP20_007: Hehe. As expected of you, Master. You know my tastes perfectly.
Present_Desc_Ronnie: An honorary guard license issued to Ronnie by the Fairy Guard. She entrusted it to me, saying she would place her fate in the Order's hands.
